title: Predictive Rollback Advisor with Canary Quarantine Sequencer
author: Asha Patel
description:
Context: Canary rollouts today rely on static thresholds for latency and error-rate gates. We see frequent manual rollbacks during transient noise and bursts of client-side retries. This PR implements a Predictive Rollback Advisor and a Canary Quarantine Sequencer to reduce noisy rollbacks and give operators a deterministic quarantined path for suspicious cohorts.

Motivation: Automatic rollback decisions should incorporate short-term signal forecasts and signal-weighted severity rather than point-threshold crossings. The Advisor forecasts 30s-2m trends on latency, 5xx rate, and output-quality regression (derived from eval hooks) and computes a rollback risk score. The Quarantine Sequencer detours flagged traffic into a shadow/quarantine lane where amplified telemetry and conservative response policies (reduced concurrency, extra KV-cache warmup, stricter timeouts) are applied while the Advisor continues monitoring. If risk stabilizes below the safe threshold, the sequencer gradually reintegrates traffic; if risk exceeds the rollback credit budget, an automated rollback is triggered.

What this PR includes: - Predictive rollback algorithm (exponential moving window + trend z-score + severity-weighted scoring) implemented in rollout/advisor/predictive.py - Quarantine sequencer controller (Go) that creates and manages a quarantined fanout lane, plus an orchestrator to move cohorts between lanes: rollout/sequencer/quarantine_controller.go - A deterministic traffic replay harness (telemetry/replay/simulator.go) to validate advisor decisions using historical traces - Telemetry probes and dashboards (telemetry/probes/*.yaml) and a set of evaluation prompts for quality regressions (e2e/evals/quarantine_prompts.json) - Integration and e2e tests: e2e/tests/quarantine_replay.test.ts and e2e/tests/rollback_credit.test.ts - Console UI change: small UX to expose quarantine status and advisor score in rollout details (console/src/components/QuarantineBadge.tsx)

Design highlights: - Risk scoring: combines short-term slope in latency, weighted error increase, and quality-loss signal into a single 0-100 score with tunable weights. - Predictive confidence window: advisor returns (score, confidence) where confidence downweights noisy signals; quarantine threshold requires both score>thresh and confidence>min_confidence to avoid flapping. - Rollback credits: each rollout gets a credit budget that permits transient high-risk windows without immediate rollback; credits replenish slowly as the candidate serves healthy traffic. - Stasis window: when moving to quarantine, sequencer enforces an initial stasis window (configurable, default 60s) to collect enriched telemetry before any auto-decision. - Audit trail: every quarantine/rollback decision is recorded with provenance (advisor inputs, model version, cohort fingerprint, recent traces) for postmortem.

Checklist: - [x] Advisor algorithm implementation and unit tests - [x] Quarantine sequencer controller and unit tests - [x] Deterministic replay harness + simulation datasets - [x] Telemetry probes and dashboard wiring - [x] E2E smoke tests for quarantine and rollback credit flow - [x] Add rollout docs and runbook links in PR body

Testing notes: - Local simulation used traffic snapshots from 2024-08 (synthesized to preserve privacy). - E2E tests run against a dedicated local cluster image. One flaky test (e2e/tests/rollback_credit.test.ts) was observed under resource pressure and was retried in CI.

Runbook (short): - If quarantine triggered unexpectedly: check advisor score drivers in the Console (latency slope vs. quality loss) and inspect enriched quarantine traces. - To temporarily disable automated rollback: set rollout.annotations.rollback-mode=manual on the rollout resource. - To adjust sensitivity: modify rollout.spec.advisor.weights and advisor.confidence_window.

Related: ENG-1427 (predictive rollbacks), SUP-3012 (customer incident linked where manual rollback was used twice in 10 mins), design doc: /docs/design/rollback-advisor.md

Notes on safety: default is conservative: quarantine only activates when both score and confidence thresholds are met and stasis window completes. Automated rollback additionally requires credit exhaustion. This aims to reduce both false positives and delayed reaction to real regressions.

review_comments: Diego Martinez: Nice approach. Please double-check the numeric stability of the z-score when traffic volume is low; consider adding a small-sample fallback (e.g., Bayesian shrinkage).
Asha Patel: Added Bayesian shrinkage fallback and unit tests in predictive.py. See new test cases for sample sizes < 50.
Lena Zhou: Concerned about the quorum for confidence. What happens for ultra-low-volume cohorts?

Asha Patel: Quarantine will not activate for cohorts below min_sample_size (configurable, default 20) and the Console surfaces that as 'insufficient data'. Added an integration test for sub-threshold cohort handling.
Priya Nair: We should ensure Dedicated customers can opt-out and that the sequencer honors tenant-level policy. Also request an enterprise config flag.
Asha Patel: Sequencer reads rollout.annotations.tenant_policy_override. Added helm value and docs snippet for Dedicated opt-out.
Diego Martinez: CI showed a flaky e2e test on first run (rollback_credit.test). We should retry on transient failures and track as flaky. Good to merge after CI green.
ci_log: CI: build: pass; unit: pass; integration: pass; e2e: one flaky test retried (rollback_credit.test) -> pass on retry; lint: pass; security-scan: pass
release_notes: Introduces a Predictive Rollback Advisor and Canary Quarantine Sequencer to reduce noisy automatic rollbacks and provide a quarantined path for suspicious cohorts. Backwards-compatible; rollout controls are opt-in via advisor config. Added telemetry, dashboards, and e2e tests.
notes: This PR is intentionally conservative by default. Operators should tune advisor weights and credit budgets per workload. Follow-up work: add ML-based quality signal integrations (ENG-1489) and a simulator-driven hyperparameter tuner.
changelog_summary: Predictive rollback scoring + quarantine sequencer, replay harness, telemetry probes, console UI, e2e tests
user_impact: Low by default (opt-in advisor). Improved signal-based quarantining aims to reduce unnecessary rollbacks. Dedicated customers can opt-out via tenant_policy_override.
post_merge_tasks: 1) Ramp rollout in staging with historical traces; 2) Run defined hyperparameter sweep in replay harness; 3) Add tutorial to Console runbook
tested_on: local minikube (dev), staging (dedicated cluster), CI replay harness
